question: Post-incident review — authentication outage — 2026-08-25
answer_note: Rohan owns token refresh fix; monitoring alert threshold decision; Priya owns runbook update

decisions: Lower the authentication error alert threshold from 5% to 1% to catch future incidents earlier.
